# Shibumi 0.2.1

2026-11-08

Hotfix release for Omarchy 4.5: validated on Omarchy 4.5.0 (package 4.5.0-3, source v4.5.0 at ac2690cd7); forward reference 84b3f287. 0.2.0 installations update in place.

## What's Changed

### Features

- **feat:** show every agent-usage provider Omarchy publishes (Fireworks, Grok and Kimi on 4.5.0) with Omarchy's own admission rules and marks; nothing is hard-wired to Claude and Codex any more (cd2f013f)
- **feat:** toggle Omarchy Stay Awake from the Quick Access idle button, so the state survives shell reloads and reboots and is shared with the Status widget and Omarchy's own indicator; hosts without the idle service keep the session-only inhibitor (requested by oko on Discord) (7c3097a1)

### Bug Fixes

- **fix:** place a plugin or foreign widget that enters the host layout while a settings write is still pending into the V2 layout once that write settles, instead of leaving it missing until the next layout change (f3c1b344)
- **fix:** read the moved per-monitor workspace state file with a legacy-path fallback (#88) (310a9e7e)
- **fix:** remove an added plugin that was dragged into a V1 base slot without failing or blocking every other plugin change; the slot is left empty (reported by oko on Discord) (2c9242b0)
- **fix:** tell status how to recover an admitted interrupted transaction (efe65076)
- **fix:** follow Omarchy's upcoming per-monitor display panel API in the brightness bridge while keeping the 4.5.0 behaviour; where the upcoming panel has no display on/off switch, Shibumi shows none either (a91f7eea)
- **fix:** keep the original Omarchy bar restorable after `deactivate --keep-layout`: `activate` no longer records Shibumi's own layout as the stock bar, `deactivate` strips suite widgets and falls back to Omarchy's default bar when nothing stock is left, and `uninstall` no longer leaves a Control Center entry behind (6caa9163)
- **fix:** keep a native-catalog refresh scheduled right before a shell handoff from throwing during teardown (c94b23bf)
- **fix:** run Reboot and Shutdown through Omarchy 4.5's `omarchy-system reboot|shutdown`, keeping hosts with the 4.0.6 scripts working (reported by oko on Discord) (792de3db)
- **fix:** settle the aurora workspace marker without a visible one-pixel step on integer-scale displays (4b825fcb)

### Maintenance

- **ci:** name the validated-assets artifact without the run attempt (3c4e45ce)
- **test:** pin the host contracts to Omarchy 4.5.0 and forward 84b3f287 (3ab042ab)
- **test:** re-pin Omarchy v4.5.0 to ac2690cd7 and the 4.5.0-3 package (7932ff58)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/HANCORE-linux/Shibumi-Shell/compare/v0.2.0...v0.2.1
